messages:
sasha: Morning async check-in. What I did: finished spanish prompt normalization + ran evals on llama3-xxlq. Found a quality drop on summarization vs baseline. Blockers: trying to repro on dedicated infra — KV warmup looks inconsistent. Today: triage regression, open PR for prompt pinning, need a quick CR on 4589, @miguel can you eyeball the eval diffs?
miguel: Taking a look now. Can you paste the eval diff or run id?
sasha: run id: run/2026-03-16-spanish-llama3-xxlq-42. Key signal: Rouge-L down ~4.2, hallucination rate up ~3%. Diff note: temperature accidentally changed from 0.0 -> 0.1 in the prompt runner (`temperature: 0.1`).
tara: Ah that would explain it. We toggled the default in the prompt runner recently. @jin flagged it in PR 4567 but missed the prompt sets. Quick fix: pin `temperature: 0.0` in the spanish promptset. I can push a tiny PR.
jin: FYI I reverted the default in staging yesterday but missed the prompt sets. I'll approve the PR if tests pass. Also for the KV warmup — can you share the trace logs? I suspect a race in cache priming.
sasha: logs: ```
[kv_warmup] primed 0/1024 keys after 45s
WARN: cache miss spike during initial 10 reqs
```
miguel: :eyes: I see a pattern — batch size varied between hosted vs dedicated. Might be a batching policy mismatch. Can we run with continuous batching disabled on the dedicated cluster for a quick repro? @deploy-bot can you spin an ephemeral dedicated node shimmer-3 for me?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ephemeral node shimmer-3-ephem-11 in us-west-2, ready. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/clusters/shimmer-3-ephem-11
tara: Thanks! I'll open PR 4589 to pin temp and add a smoke test for Spanish summarization. Assigning to @jin for review.
jin: On it. Quick question: do we want to roll the prompt change as a canary? If it fixes only the template bug it's okay to full rollout, but prefer canary.
sasha: Canary first please. If we see perf + no regressions on other languages we roll. Also need a quick eval rerun: `eval-run --id run/2026-03-16-spanish-llama3-xxlq-42 --with-pr 4589`
eval-bot: eval-bot: queued eval rerun (job 98765). ETA ~12m. Will post results.
miguel: Heads up: PR 4567 diff includes a change to tokenization for spanish. If pinning temp doesn't help we should revert tokenization change and re-eval. I'll run a focused tokenization test.
tara: :thumbsup: ping me when the eval job finishes. If it's green I'll merge 4589 and canary it.
eval-bot: eval-bot: job 98765 complete. Summary: Rouge-L +3.7 (restored), hallucination rate down 2.8. Full artifact: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/evals/98765. Looks like pinning temperature fixed most of it.
sasha: Nice — thanks team. Next steps: merge 4589, canary to 5% for an hour, monitor token-level latency & error rate. I'll write a short runbook for oncall.
miguel: Added canary to rollout config. I'll keep an eye on latency charts. Also left a CR comment on 4589 about adding a changelog entry.
tara: Merged 4589; canary set to 5% in config. :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for promptset/spanish-pin-temp at 5%. Traces enabled.
jin: If canary passes over +1h, schedule full rollout. Thanks everyone — off to standup.
